bisimulation_boundary.classification: Boundary only: bisimulation of given action contracts does not certify an unprovided state-dependent terminal/STOP cost. Include STOP/terminal contract or require block-constant terminal value before using it for finite_meta_dp.

iterator_defect.finding: decision_regions repeatedly tests membership in a one-shot good_actions[state] iterator; a missing first action exhausts it and loses the actual later action.
